description_en: Creates a temporary instance for an RDS instance that runs SQL Server 2008 R2 and uses local disks
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS SQL Server 2008 R2高性能本地盘实例创建临时实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-temp-db-instance --db-instance-id rm-bp130000 --backup-id 18830000 --restore-time 2023-06-11T16:00:00Z --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTempDBInstance

parameters.help_en:
The backup set ID. You can call the DescribeBackups operation to query the backup set ID.

You must specify at least one of BackupId and RestoreTime parameters
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。可通过接口DescribeBackups查询。
BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The specified point in time within the backup retention period. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The time can be set to a point in time within the last seven days and must be more than 30 minutes earlier than the current time. The default time zone is UTC.
You must specify at least one of the BackupId and RestoreTime parameters
parameters.help_zh: 用户指定备份保留时间内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 可以设置为7天之内并且早于当前时间半小时以上的任意时间点，默认时区为UTC。 BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: restore_time
